page.overview:
Who is Bulpan?

Bulpan sports Pan's front bangs, facial features, eye shape, and an orange bandana on her head. She has Bulla's hairstyle and blue eyes and wears her gold choker and gold hoop earrings. She also wears a short red T-shirt, which comes from Pan, black fingerless gloves that go up to her shoulders, and a black mini skirt with a yellow belt buckle, with Pan's chains on the right side. Her red thigh-high boots are a mix of Pan's and Bulla's shoes. She wears the Metamo-Ring on her left arm.

Bulpan is precocious like Bulla and tough like Pan. She considers herself to be attractive and cute, though is quick to point out to Tekka not to underestimate her power just because of her appearance.

As a result of Bulla and Pan's strong affinity due to their friendship and their Saiyan blood, their profile description implies they are the ultimate female fusion. Additionally, like all EX-Fusions, Bulpan can remain fused as long as she wishes.

By performing Five-Way Fusion with any four members of Tekka's Team, Bulpan can fuse with them to produce an Ultra Fusion. If initiated by Bulpan herself, it will result in a female Earthling Ultra Fusion.
